package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"github.com/waiting-here/NonbiriAPI/internal/db"
	"github.com/waiting-here/NonbiriAPI/internal/secret"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"testing"
)

func TestWritePreviousGatewayFixture(t *testing.T) {
	directory := os.Getenv("NONBIRI_GATEWAY_FIXTURES")
	if directory == "" {
		t.Fatal("missing fixture directory")
	}
	f := newEmbeddingHTTPFixture(t)
	for _, model := range []string{"provider/self", "[公益]provider/per_request", "[公益]provider/per_token"} {
		status, body := f.call(t, model, `["first","second"]`, "float", "")
		if status != 200 {
			t.Fatalf("populate billing: %d %s", status, body)
		}
	}
	count, generation := make([]byte, 16), make([]byte, 16)
	count[15] = 19
	generation[15] = 7
	f.exec(t, "UPDATE donation_keys SET failure_streak=?,streak_generation=?,failure_disabled=1,enabled=0", count, generation)
	f.exec(t, `INSERT INTO site_config(key,value,updated_at) VALUES('legal_terms_override_en','Preserved custom policy',1) ON CONFLICT(key) DO UPDATE SET value=excluded.value`)
	if err := f.app.Close(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if _, err := f.store.DB().Exec(`VACUUM INTO ?`, filepath.Join(directory, "prior.db")); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}

func TestPreviousBinaryRejectsGatewayUpgrade(t *testing.T) {
	directory := os.Getenv("NONBIRI_GATEWAY_FIXTURES")
	if directory == "" {
		t.Fatal("missing fixture directory")
	}
	vault, err := secret.New(bytes.Repeat([]byte{0x63}, secret.MasterKeyBytes))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer vault.Close()
	path := filepath.Join(directory, "upgraded.db")
	before, err := os.ReadFile(path)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	store, err := db.Open(path, vault)
	if store != nil {
		store.Close()
		t.Fatal("previous binary accepted newer storage")
	}
	if err == nil {
		t.Fatal("expected rejection")
	}
	after, err := os.ReadFile(path)
	if err != nil || sha256.Sum256(before) != sha256.Sum256(after) {
		t.Fatal("rejection modified source", err)
	}
	for _, suffix := range []string{"-wal", "-shm"} {
		if _, err := os.Stat(path + suffix); !os.IsNotExist(err) {
			t.Fatal("rejection created sidecar", suffix, err)
		}
	}
}
